production_source_comparison.interpretation: All production/build sources match the tested cloud artifact except the listed retained user extensions. Post-build changes are evidence/tests/documentation.

limits: No real hardware setting, voltage/stability measurement or physical core mapping has been verified.
Only Shimada family 1Ah/model 08h at PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0 is admitted for the new setting API.
CCD selection is explicit individual-core updates, not an atomic operation or a broadcast command; failures may leave earlier changes.
Per-core/CCD PM telemetry layout remains unresolved. Other AMD profiles, native PM transport, Intel server controls and board-specific settings remain incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a full application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; Secure Boot and actual register settings were not tested.

visual_review.scope: Six images manually viewed: Ubuntu 24.04 and Oracle Linux 7.9; selection, successful readback and partial failure. Other images not individually reviewed.
findings: Targets and signed/hex values are readable without clipping.
Success shows each core with matching readback.
Partial failure distinguishes verified core 0, attempted core 2 and untouched core 7; status reports where the operation stopped.

cautions: Ghidra rebases original ELF addresses by 0x100000; file-offset resolution and exact symbol identity were checked.
Mixed calling conventions make several pseudo-code PCI arguments incorrect. Original instruction operands remain authoritative.
A8 is a firmware query, not a portable constant. It is not added to the runtime allowlist.
The int constructor uses a different layout/count path from the default constructor and get_pm_patch. Do not mix their offsets.
Public setter command 06 and low-16-bit count encoding supplement original setter evidence. Original D5-plus-06 sequences and port scans are not reproduced.
Curve readback compares exact canonical signed-32-bit counts; physical voltage, core mapping and machine stability remain untested.

offset_query_call_gate.observation: A zero flag branches past the A8 wrapper call at 0x7646d8. A nonzero flag calls it and formats the returned word for a Qt field.
offset_query_call_gate.limitation: This identifies the original platform path, not a validated MP1 initialization/response protocol or PM-table schema.

original_instruction_evidence.scope: Original instruction execution with synthetic object, PCI, delay, mutex and MP1 boundaries; no constructor port scan or hardware run.
observations: Original setter sends D5 then 06/07, writes the argument three times, and reads after unlocking.
Negative original per-core inputs retain reserved/CCX bits; new low-16-bit encoding follows the pinned public command contract.
Original calls ignore injected PCI write failures and do not wait for response completion.
The A8 offset wrapper returns the output word regardless of MP1 status; no runtime query is enabled from this finding.

local_tests.timing: Added after runtime commit 8c5424b; these three evidence tests ran locally, not in its 108-test cloud analysis suite.
